title: Guest Services Academy Questions on Dining Persons for the Ashbury Rewards Dining Allowance (Guest Folios)
content:
The dining persons of an Ashbury Rewards member's dining allowance on Guest Folios follow the number of adults registered in the room.

**Rule.** Dining persons: when the reservation behind the folio registers three or more adults, the dining persons are the registered adults, up to the maximum dining persons of 4; when it registers exactly one adult, one person. Any other reservation keeps the brand's persons covered as its dining persons; this rule makes no change to it.

The registered adults are the number of adults registered in the room on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio.

## Questions and answers

**Where is the number of adults taken from?** From the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio, not from the number of diners at the table.

**Three adults are registered. How many dining persons?** Three.

**Five adults are registered.** Four: the registered adults are taken up to the maximum dining persons of 4.

**One adult is registered.** One dining person.

**Two adults are registered.** This rule makes no change: the brand's persons covered stand.

**Does the member's tier change the dining persons?** No. The dining persons follow the registered adults alone.

| Adults registered | Dining persons |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | Unchanged (the brand's persons covered) |
| 3 | 3 |
| 4 | 4 |
| 5 or more | 4 |
